retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style group portrait featuring four men in dark turtlenecks with blue sashes, set against a dense green foliage background with stylized, stacked typography in the upper left.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring four men arranged in a triangular formation within a lush, leafy environment. The lighting is soft and naturalistic, with a warm, slightly aged color cast. The typography is contained within a white-bordered shape in the top left corner, featuring a mix of heavy, stylized block letters and outlined sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group integrated into dense green foliage
Typography anchored to the top-left corner within a graphic container
Uniform dark clothing with contrasting blue diagonal sashes
Record label logo positioned in the bottom-right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the central and lower two-thirds of the frame in a tiered arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary anchor is the group of four men, with the secondary anchor being the typographic block in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright typography in the top left, moves down through the faces of the group, and settles on the record label logo in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with subjects and dense foliage.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with deep shadows and warm highlights, typical of vintage film.

letterConstructionRules: Top line features interlocking, heavy block letters with sharp angles
Lower lines use a condensed, outlined sans-serif with a slight vertical stack
All text is contained within a white-bordered graphic shape
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' and 'N' in the top line are merged
The 'S' has a sharp, aggressive terminal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block display paired with outlined condensed sans-serif for a layered, 70s look.
graphicDevices: Small square logo box in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the secondary text.
Matches the unique interlocking style of the primary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of four men in 1970s attire (dark turtlenecks with blue sashes) standing in a dense, leafy forest with soft natural lighting and a vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white-bordered graphic box in the top-left corner. Inside, place heavy block lettering for the main title and stacked, red-outlined condensed sans-serif for the subtitle.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within a white-bordered shape?
Are the men wearing turtlenecks and sashes?
Is the color palette warm and vintage?

adjustableVariables: Specific arrangement of the four subjects
Exact shape of the typographic container
mustRedesign: Modern digital clarity (must maintain vintage grain)
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1970s film texture and grain
Ensure the typography is in the top-left corner
Verify the presence of four subjects in uniform-style clothing
Confirm the foliage background is dense and fills the frame
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Soul Group Aesthetic = (Four-person tiered portrait + 70s fashion) * (Dense foliage background) + (Top-left corner graphic typographic lockup)
